description: Réseau cyclable is a dataset listed in Observatoire du Climat open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Toulouse Métropole. Les aménagements du réseau cyclable se distinguent en 3 catégories: site propre: pistes cyclables, voies vertes et trottoirs, autres (passage inférieur et passerelle) sur chaussée: vélos rues, doubles sens cyclables, chaussées à voie centrale banalisée, couloirs bus, contre-allées et bandes cyclables réseau vert Lorsqu'un aménagement est présent de part et autre d'une voie, on ne ... Coverage: Toulouse Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are mobilité, vélo, réseau cyclable, piste cyclable, voie verte, trottoir. The portal shows 10 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2025-05-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-observatoire-climat-toulouse-metropole-portal.
